verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a documented public Developer API. Live probes confirm a 174-path OpenAPI spec at /openapi/developer-api.json and a machine-readable llms.txt index. The docs cover OAuth 2.0 client-credentials and authorization-code flows with granular resource:permission scopes, a sandbox environment, webhooks, and write endpoints such as end-to-end bill creation and payment. For AI-native use, the API is complemented by an agent-mode JSON CLI and an OAuth-gated MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the API in practice; some surfaces (incorporation) are private-preview, and banking endpoints are flagged as subject to breaking changes.
